title: Markets: Where We Deliver Charging Projects | Anari
meta: 22 countries in service across the Middle East, Caucasus and Central Asia, Europe, Asia, Africa and Latin America — each with its deciding constraint.

sections.h1: Emerging markets, not the mature ones where price decides.
sections.lede: We work where the grid is the constraint and the operating model still has to be designed. 22 countries in service, grouped by the factor that decides projects there.

sections.h2: Four things decide whether a country works
sections.lede: We do not enter a market because it looks attractive on a growth chart. These four decide whether a project there is buildable and serviceable.

items.title: Grid capacity
items.text: What the local utility will actually approve, and how long the connection takes. This decides half the projects before equipment is discussed.

items.title: Climate envelope
items.text: Sustained 45 °C+ heat, monsoon humidity or −30 °C cold — each changes the cooling, sealing and heating specification.

items.title: Service access
items.text: Whether a fault can be fixed in days or weeks. It decides between modular field-serviceable units and sealed cabinets.

items.title: Certification & paperwork
items.text: CE, local grid codes, import documentation and subsidy or grant requirements, which often decide the timeline more than the hardware.
